item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"piece_id":"01","ready":false,"issues":["Catch-all argument: combines Backflip, Cableteque, and Uni-Fab observations into one unsupported conclusion instead of separately typed inferences.","Catch-all synthesis: links three producers’ workflows under one broad “staged engineering workflows” inference; split the producer facts and use narrowly scoped two-source inferences.","Locator accuracy: 01-c1’s quote, “Backflip got it exactly correct,” does not support the stated two-challenge mass, Fusion-import, and material-assignment details.","Unsupported detail: 01-c3’s locator supports only flagging unrecognized or likely-missing parts, not structured BOM construction or the specific terminals, seals, and cavity plugs claimed.","Catch-all claim: 01-c5 combines visual checks, physics checks, rerun checks, and grasp testing from separate transcript segments; split these into focused source claims with their own locators.","Mixed claim types: 01-c6 combines the podcast’s reported evaluation protocol with an editorial inference about comparative rigor; separate the reported fact from the inference.","Locator accuracy: 01-c6’s segment identifies the task, attempt, timing, and scoring protocol but not that the evaluation was blind or external; cite the relevant separate segments or narrow the statement.","Overstatement: the argument implies the cited examples demonstrate a general shift toward workflow-specific verification; the evidence shows individual, differently scoped workflows, not a market-wide change.","Freshness framing: Uni-Fab’s machining outcome is presented as a monthly development, but the video reports work done “over the last few years”; identify the recent item as newly reported rather than a new result."]}
